Name: High Water Cut
Description: Producer water cut exceeds defined threshold

Name: Low Oil Production
Description: Oil production falls below defined threshold

Name: Combined Production Deficit
Description: High water cut combined with low oil production

Name: Low Injection Rate
Description: Injector falls below target injection rate

Name: Inactive Well
Description: Well is shut-in or under maintenance

Name: Production Decline
Description: Significant decrease in oil production compared with previous measurements
